name: private-shop
description: Private members shop — a realistic stand-in for a customer's existing site with login. AUTH_MODE selects how authentication is verified: cookie-jwt (HMAC JWT), cookie-session (server-side session), headers (X-Forwarded-User from upstream), mfa-filtered (hands off to TOTP filter), or mfa-verify (validates TOTP challenge ticket).

params.name: AUTH_MODE
params.descr: Authentication mode. Selects which strategy the shop uses to verify identity.

params.name: SESSION_SECRET
params.descr: Random 32-byte base64url string. Required for cookie-jwt mode — signs and verifies the session JWT. Not used in cookie-session or headers modes.

params.name: JWKS_URL
params.descr: URL of a JWKS endpoint. When set, the app also accepts an upstream SSO session cookie (e.g. from saml-app) verified against this endpoint, enabling SSO passthrough alongside local login.

params.name: SESSION_COOKIE
params.descr: Name of the upstream SSO session cookie to verify when JWKS_URL is set. Defaults to sso_session.

params.name: PASSWORD
params.descr: Demo site login password accepted for any username. Defaults to authme. Change this for any non-demo deployment.
